mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cap_result_event (event_id, tenant_id, run_id, invocation_id, terminal_event_id, result_status, result_payload, reason_code, created_at) VALUES (#{eventId}::uuid, #{tenantId}::uuid, #{runId}::uuid, #{invocationId}, #{terminalEventId}, #{resultStatus}::cap_result_status, #{resultPayload}::jsonb, #{reasonCode}, #{createdAt}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, invocation_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT event_id::text, tenant_id::text, run_id::text, invocation_id, terminal_event_id, result_status, result_payload::text, reason_code, created_at FROM cap_result_event WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND invocation_id = #{invocationId}
